summary_en: Career Co. authorized repurchase of up to 60,000 shares (0.72% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥20 million through open market purchase on TSE Growth from November 16, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to prepare for future M&A and capital partnerships.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Career Co. announced on November 13, 2026 that its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 60,000 treasury shares (0.72% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥20 million. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market between November 16, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the repurchase is intended to provide flexibility for future M&A transactions and capital partnerships. The authorization is based on the company's articles of incorporation, which permit the board to determine treasury stock acquisitions in accordance with the Companies Act.
